I got this from the page text the browser extract saved to disk, not from a visual check of the lead. The extracted text has the sentence ahead of the footnote-style lines, which is consistent with it being in the lead, but I didn't confirm its position against the History heading. A later footnote also gives May 15, 2015 as the date Rust 1.0 became the first stable release.
